title: Dual manifest compatibility for Claude-first repositories

sources.title: Consider adding a .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest for Codex discoverability

key_findings: A practical migration pattern is to keep the existing .claude-plugin manifest and add a .codex-plugin manifest alongside it.
Codex discoverability is tied directly to the presence of .codex-plugin/plugin.json, even for repositories that already ship Claude plugins.
Community feedback frames the Codex manifest as the low-risk compatibility layer rather than a full repository rewrite.
recommended_actions: Preserve the Claude plugin manifests untouched and add parallel Codex manifests.
Reuse stable plugin names and versions across both manifests to avoid identity drift.
Document which repository surfaces remain host-specific after the Codex port.
